facts.statement: Pontotoc County residents shopping for individual health insurance on HealthCare.gov have 43 medical plans to choose from for 2027. Three insurers offer them, according to a county-by-county federal listing updated Nov. 16. For coverage to start Jan. 1, the deadline to enroll or change plans is Tuesday, Dec. 15. The first premium must also be paid.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County residents shopping for individual health insurance on HealthCare.gov have 43 medical plans to choose from for 2027. Three insurers offer them, according to a county-by-county federal listing updated Nov. 16. For coverage to start Jan. 1, the deadline to enroll or change plans is Tuesday, Dec. 15. The first premium must also be paid.

Ambetter Health lists 19 plans in the county, UnitedHealthcare lists 15 and Oscar Health Plan lists nine. Shoppers comparing plans by metal level will find 16 Silver plans and 12 Gold. The other 15 are Bronze options, including 12 that the federal file labels Expanded Bronze.

For one 40-year-old adult, the lowest monthly premium listed for Pontotoc County is $704.97 for an Expanded Bronze plan. The lowest Silver premium for the same example is $804.45 a month. These are prices before any premium tax credit. Household size and income can affect the price an applicant sees after completing the Marketplace application.

Free application help is available in Tupelo. Access Family Health lists certified application counselor Dot Marie Buck at 662-690-8007, extension 6292. The office is at 499 Gloster Creek Village, Suite D1. Its listed hours are 8 a.m. to 4:45 p.m. Monday through Thursday and 8 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Friday.

People who miss the Dec. 15 date can still enroll during open enrollment. For those who select or change plans from Dec. 16 through Jan. 15 and pay the first premium, HealthCare.gov lists Feb. 1 as the coverage start date.
